text.atmosphericfauna.cloth_missing: Cloth Config is missing! Please install it to access these settings.
option.atmosphericfauna.chunk_load_spawn: Enables ambient fauna spawning system when new chunks are loaded.
option.atmosphericfauna.ambient_spawning: Enables regular checks for spawning ambient fauna in the world.
option.atmosphericfauna.midair_border_sp: Enables spawning of ambient fauna at the edge of render distance, even if it is in midair (good for skyblock or similar).
option.atmosphericfauna.spawn_range_from: Sets the maximum distance from the player within which ambient fauna can spawn.
option.atmosphericfauna.spawn_tick_delay: Sets the delay (in ticks) between ambient spawn attempts.
option.atmosphericfauna.attempts_per_tic: Sets the number of spawn attempts per tick.
option.atmosphericfauna.search_radius.to: Sets the radius around the chosen spawn point to search for a valid spawn position.
option.atmosphericfauna.spawn_below_sea_: Determines whether ambient fauna can spawn below sea level.
option.atmosphericfauna.spawn_around_spe: Allows ambient fauna to spawn around players in Spectator mode.
option.atmosphericfauna.max_active_birds: Sets the absolute maximum number of all active birds combined in the world at any given time.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.enable_s: Allows this species to be selected by the ambient spawning system.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.max_acti: Sets the maximum number of active birds of this species in the world at any given time.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.ignore_b: Disables spawn biome checks, allowing this species to spawn in any biome.
Disables spawn block checks, allowing this species to spawn above any block.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.min_pack: Sets the smallest number of birds of this species that can spawn together as a flock.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.max_pack: Sets the largest number of birds of this species that can spawn together as a flock.
option.atmosphericfauna.species.max_floc: Sets the largest number of birds of this species that will flock together while flying before splitting off. Set to 0 for no limit.
option.atmosphericfauna.enable_bird_dist: Fades bird sprites as they approach the render distance limit.
option.atmosphericfauna.enable_hit_parti: Shows particle effects when birds are hit.
option.atmosphericfauna.debug_text_spawn: Enables console debug text for ambient spawning in the world.
option.atmosphericfauna.debug_text_birds: Enables console debug text for bird particles in the world.
option.atmosphericfauna.enable_debug_scr: Automatically enables the debug screen overlay when joining a world.
